subject: general
question: Celebrated Urdu poet and bollywood writer-director Gulzar was honoured with which of the following awards in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jnanpith Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jnanpith Award** is one of the highest literary honors presented annually in India.
 
• It was instituted in **1961** by the Bharatiya Jnanpith organization.
 
• This award recognizes and honors **authors** for their contribution to literature in any of the 22 languages listed in the **Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• Celebrated Urdu poet and Bollywood writer-director **Gulzar** was bestowed with the Jnanpith Award for his exceptional contribution to Indian literature and poetry.
 
• Gulzar is known for his **profound poetry**, **screenwriting**, and lyric writing for Bollywood films.
 
• The award includes a **cash prize**, a citation, and a bronze replica of Goddess Saraswati.
 
• This recognition further highlights Gulzar's remarkable achievements in **Urdu literature** and his significant impact on the cultural and literary sphere of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**__

 __
 
• The **Padma Vibhushan** is the second-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in various fields such as **arts, literature, science, public affairs, etc.**
 
• Instituted in **1954**, it is given annually on the recommendation of the Padma Awards Committee.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri**__
 __
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It recognizes individuals for their **distinguished contributions** to various fields such as **arts, education, literature, sports, social work, etc.**
 
• It was instituted in **1954**, along with other Padma awards.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan**__
 
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is the third-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded for **distinguished service of a high order** across various disciplines, including **arts, literature, and public service.**
 
• First instituted in **1954**, it is conferred annually by the Government of India.
